# intel471-api-patterns

When working on code that calls the Intel 471 Titan or Verity471 APIs, follow
[`skills/intel471-api-patterns/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/intel471/integrations-skills/blob/main/skills/intel471-api-patterns/SKILL.md).
